sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Hallie J. Witt.
Hallie J. Witt is listed as a records specialist in the latest available Transparent Utah records for fiscal year 2026.
The AFPD directories printed August 17 and September 28, 2026, list Hallie J. Witt under GRAMA, documenting her assignment to public records requests.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records list Hallie J. Witt's work for American Fork from fiscal year 2023 through 2026. The latest listed position is Records Specialist.

Compensation years reflect reported pay, not exact hire or departure dates. The department directories provide separate dated documentation of her listed assignment; their printed dates do not establish when that assignment began or ended.
